title: ネイチャさんとお疲れトレーナー

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's been a busy few days, but it's finally over…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Deciding to treat myself, I drag my tired body to the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hey there, Trainer! Wait up!
choice_data_list: Nature?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I knew you were busy, but I didn't expect you to push yourself this hard.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I can't stand seeing you like this, so here, let me treat you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: The shop's not open yet, so there aren't any customers. Why don't you wait in the karaoke section in the back?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature brings me to the corner of a bar.
choice_data_list: Where are we?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I know the lady who owns this place. She said we could use this space after I explained the situation.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'll go make something simple… I can't guarantee it'll be good, though.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few minutes later, Nice Nature comes back with some fried rice.
choice_data_list: All of this, for me?
All of this, for me?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: She said I should feed you as much as you need.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Go ahead and start eating before it gets cold.
choice_data_list: Whoa! You could totally open a restaurant!
Whoa! You could totally open a restaurant!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The fried rice not only looks professionally prepared, but it tastes like it too! I can't stop eating.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You're so dramatic. It's just something I picked up from when I used to help my mo—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Holy cow! You've already finished?
choice_data_list: It was just that good.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: No need for flattery. You must've been starving. Here, give me the plate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I watch her as she leaves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maybe it's because I just ate so much, but I start to drift off…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: La… la la… ♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …La la la… ♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh? Did I wake you up?
choice_data_list: What were you singing?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It's a song my mom used to sing at the counter. I don't really know much beyond the melody though.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I was thinking about those times and just started singing… Sorry.
choice_data_list: Actually, I wanted to hear more.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You and your flattery again. It's not necessary, you know.
choice_data_list: I really do like your singing.
If you sing like that at concerts, it'll be perfect!
If you sing like that at concerts, it'll be perfect!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You and your flattery again. It's not necessary, you know.
choice_data_list: I really do like your singing.
If you sing like that at concerts, it'll be perfect!
If you sing like that at concerts, it'll be perfect!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: O-okay, if you say so. You really are strange…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But I'm relieved that you said you liked it, instead of saying my singing is "good."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That kind of pressure really gets to me, you know? It makes it all the worse when I end up not living up to such praise.
choice_data_list: Nature…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Haha, sorry for getting serious.
choice_data_list: I like it when you share your serious thoughts too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: What… You're crazy…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You keep saying things like that, and it'll lose its meaning.

text_block_list.name: Bar Owner
text_block_list.text: Are you all done, Natie?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Thanks for letting us use the bar. It was a huge help.

text_block_list.name: Bar Owner
text_block_list.text: You must be the trainer Natie's been talking about. She's told me so much ab—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oookay! That's enough! Let's go, Trainer!
choice_data_list: So you've been talking about me?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: We're. Done. Here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The owner watches us warmly as we take off.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wow… You're still thinking about winning concerts even after working so much?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: This has been on my mind for a while now, but… aren't you pushing yourself a little too hard?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I feel like you'll burn out if I don't keep my eye on you.
choice_data_list: That won't happen.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I beg to differ.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: One sec. I'll go make you a rice ball for later.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You're just going to continue working when you get home, right?
choice_data_list: You know me too well.
You know me too well.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hey! At least pretend like you won't!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I leave the bar with a loving lecture and a late-night snack from Nice Nature.
